references.text: The description of the tabernacle (מִּשְׁכָּן) and its furnishings referred to in Exodus 27:19
Mentions the pegs (יְתֵדֹת) for the tabernacle and the courtyard, using the same terminology as in 27:19
All the pegs for the tabernacle and the surrounding courtyard were made of bronze (נְחֹשֶׁת), a direct parallel
Describes the pegs for the courtyard being made of bronze, fulfilling the instruction in 27:19
The Levites' responsibility for the tabernacle's furnishings, including the courtyard pegs
The Merarite Levites' responsibility for the pillars and their pegs (יִתְדֹתָם) of the courtyard
Earlier in the chapter, bronze (נְחֹשֶׁת) is mentioned as the material for the altar's utensils
Summary of all the furnishings for the tabernacle and its service, including pegs
Complementary image: Bronze for sockets/pegs (earth) versus silver for the pillars (atonement).
Confirmation that all the sockets in the sanctuary must be made of bronze.
